record.question:
(a) Can a childless widow of a deceased Government servant be continued to be paid Family Pension even after her re-marriage? If No, why? If Yes, under what circumstances?
(b) Mention at least 5 (five) periods of service counted as qualifying service for pension.
(c) Differentiate 'emoluments' for the purpose of 'Pension' and 'Gratuity'.
(d) What is 'Pension'? Name the different classes of Pension.
(e) In what manner does additional pension admissible to a retired Government servant after completion of 80(eighty) years of age and above.

paper.title: CCS (PENSION) RULES, 1972 / CCS (CONDUCT) RULES, 1964 / MIZORAM POLICE ACT-2011
